articles.title: Buzzing stocks: Central Bank, DalmiaCement, Eicher Motors, Tejas Networks, Cryogenic OGS, others
articles.summary: The Government of India, via the Ministry of Finance, has commenced divesting its stake in Central Bank of India through an Offer for Sale (OFS). This strategic move aims to reduce government ownership in the public sector bank, aligning with broader economic reforms to potentially enhance efficiency and encourage private sector participation in the Indian banking system. It reflects a significant national financial policy decision.

articles.title: Bengaluru rain update: Bangalore braces for intense showers, thunderstorms and strong winds as IMD issues yellow alert till May 24
articles.summary: Bengaluru is under a yellow alert from the India Meteorological Department (IMD), anticipating intense rainfall, thunderstorms, and lightning today. This follows disruptions experienced on Thursday, indicating potential widespread impact on daily life in the city due to the severe weather conditions. Residents are advised to take necessary precautions as the weather department forecasts continued challenging conditions.
